title: smoothline
description: vanilla modpack that adds tons of optimization, QoL and visual mods for the best playing expirience you can get
body:
## ✨ about the pack

smoothline makes minecraft feel fresh, alive and responsive — like “actions & stuff” for java edition.
it’s built to look great, feel smooth, and run fast. no unnecessary bloat, no lag spikes — just fluid gameplay with nice animations, clean ui, and small visual touches that make the world feel cozy.

# ⚙️ mods

## ⚡ performance

this pack includes a bunch of optimization and rendering mods that keep fps high even with shaders and visuals enabled.
you can expect:

- faster chunk loading
- smoother lighting
- zero lag spikes in large worlds
- overall stable fps even on mid-range pcs

everything’s balanced so it runs light but still looks amazing.

## 🌿 visuals & immersion

smoothline focuses on animation, atmosphere and small details:

- smooth player & mob animations that bring everything to life
- falling leaves, rippling water, glowing ores, ambient sounds
- realistic lighting and shadows with iris shaders
- detailed world textures and animated items
- darker, minimalistic ui that fits perfectly with the vibe

## 🧩 quality of life

you’ll find a lot of tweaks that make the game feel cleaner and more comfortable:

- better menus, tooltips, and interface
- smarter controls and scrolling
- easier item management
- quick info about items, blocks and effects
- optional voice chat support for multiplayer
- it keeps everything feeling like vanilla — just smoother and more modern.

# 🎨 resource packs
- **action and stuff tools** - adds detailed models and stylish tools, inspired by the actions & stuff feel.
- **activity 3d stuff** - adds 3d elements and extra depth to certain blocks and items.
- **animated items** - gives subtle motion to tools and weapons.
- **baby animals remastered** - reworks baby mobs with smoother, cuter animations.
- **dark loading screen** - simple dark loading screen to match the clean ui.
- **detailed animations** - adds more movement and life to players and mobs.
- **eating animation** - smooth custom food-eating animation.
- **enchantment outlines** - better enchantment glows and highlights.
- **even better enchants** - refined enchant visuals and effects.
- **fresh animations** - fully remade mob animations — looks modern and fluid.
- **freeh moves** - smoother walking and idle player motions.
- **gui revision dark** - darker interface theme that’s easy on the eyes.
- **icons** - replaces old ui icons with clean modern ones.
- **new glowing ores** - subtle glowing effect for ores.
- **recolorful containers** - recolored container textures for variety.
- **simple grass flowers** - tiny decorative grass and flowers.
- **xali’s enhanced vanilla** - overall improved vanilla look with better textures and lighting.
